batch: playtest round 11: rendered proof of the curse line, and tools for the unexplained sighting
share: /Volumes/Adam Assets/Unreal/Builds/Share/The Battle of ATL Mac Playtest 113

packaged_sweep.note: The first sweep lost BattleMurderKAudit to an empty log (the app never started); it passes on retry, so run_quick_audits.sh now retries an audit once when its log is empty.

rendered_proof.shows: PEDESTRIAN: WALK MUCH?! in the subtitle slot, rider still up on the bike (arcade)
rendered_proof.how: added -BattleCurseReviewDir=<absolute path> to -BattleCurseAudit, which requests the frame while the shout is live

tools_added.what: names every actor around the rider - class, label, every mesh part with its world position, tags and visibility - nearest first, then quits. Default radius 120 m.
tools_added.why: the editor cannot see it: park furniture, ammo bins, spare bikes and pickups are all spawned at runtime, so an editor actor dump looks empty and this sighting kept getting guessed at

tools_added.what: editor-side companion that dumps placed actors (label, class, meshes, location) for the whole map

parks the rider at a coordinate and renders from their own view. It had never worked: it used FParse::Param, which does not match '-Flag=value', it sat inside the duck-review block, and the FString overload of FParse::Value stops at the first comma. All three fixed; verified with SpotReview: spot=X=-10500.000 Y=-3000.000 Z=-54.602 yaw=45

what_was_ruled_out: not a placed map actor - the editor dump of PiedmontWorld has no cylinder-shaped props near the lake or the gate
not the park bin (ammo bin) - renders as a green bin with a rim, seen up close in work/prop-review/crop-bin.png
not the cola pickup - renders as a small red can (M_ColaRed)
not the time/speed pickup - renders as a glowing disc (work/pickup-review/bike.png)
not the Trees ATL sign - it is spawned 90 m from BattleHomeData::Gate at Krog/Cabbagetown, not in the park
not the spare bike - renders as a normal bike (work/prop-review/bike.png, next to the AMMO label)
open_question.next_step: ask Elliott where and when he sees it; -BattleSpotReview plus -BattlePropProbe at that coordinate names it in one run

verification_debt: BattleRoadContactAudit and BattleKrogRiderAudit still need a quiet machine.
The nine audits that fail identically on packaged 110 are untouched this round (disc, drone, frisbee, melee, panic, skater, speed, time, tutorial).
